text:
Marta Li: Heads up  route cost card shows -22% for model-x-quant canary but the chargeback ledger only shows -2%. same timeframe. anyone seen this mismatch?
Samir Patel: Two obvious places: batching assumptions and amortization of quantization/transcode costs. Console preview historically uses an "aggressive" batch_profile (best-case) while chargeback uses observed batch sizes from telemetry.
Marta Li: Is batch_profile surfaced anywhere?
Oliver King: We added `batch_profile` and `kv_hit_rate` to the preview API months ago but kept Console hidden. Example payload we support: POST /api/cost_preview {route: "route-foo", batch_profile: "aggressive|observed|conservative", kv_hit_rate: 0.6, amortization_days: 7} (Console currently sets batch_profile=aggressive, amortization_days=7).
Priya Narayanan: Chargeback also includes a one-time quantization/transcode overhead that we amortize over 30 days in billing. Preview amortizes over 7d which inflates short-term savings.
Samir Patel: Product safety proposal: Console defaults should match chargeback-facing defaults -> batch_profile=observed, amortization_days=30, and show an "Advanced" toggle for aggressive/short amortization. That avoids surprising customers.
Marta Li: Could we show an inline driver diff? e.g., "Drivers: +batching:+12%, +kv_hit: -3%, amortization:+13%" so owners understand why values differ.
Oliver King: Yes. We'll return a drivers string and a confidence_band. API will include simple metadata (drivers as a CSV string, confidence_band as Low|Med|High) to keep the UI simple. Also add a subtle banner when advanced settings are non-default: "Estimates use non-default batching/amortization; results may differ from billing."
Priya Narayanan: I'll file tests that run preview with observed telemetry samples to ensure parity with chargeback sim. QA should add a regression that compares preview->chargeback within a 5% band for common routes.
deploy-bot: Created PR https://redwood.internal/pulls/5021 "console: expose batch_profile & amortization alignment with chargeback" by Priya Narayanan
Samir Patel: Small UX asks: 1) show the amortization window in the card header, 2) make the drivers diff easy to copy, 3) add link to docs explaining transcode amortization math.
Marta Li: Thanks  that should prevent more surprises in the next demo to product.
Priya Narayanan: On it, filing follow-ups and will link tests in the PR. :thumbsup:
